supplier: mylife Diabetes Care Ltd (formerly Ypsomed Ltd)

decisions.why: Every product actually captured in this division is a pump consumable or accessory: Myinset, Myinserter, Myorbit, Myorbit Infusion Sets, Myorbit Inserter, Mypump Reservoir, Ypsopump Carrying Systems, Ypsopump Ancillaries And Accessories. The three Ypsopump items sit UNDER /infusion-systems/ypsopump-insulin-pump/ as sub-pages (an explorer tool and its landing page); the pump's own product page was dropped by the crawler's category-landing-page prefix test, so no pump product record was captured here. Mapped to pumpset only. diabetes:pump stays empty until a real pump product page is captured — an honest empty category, not a reason to file consumables under it. Both types were added to the gated vocabulary on 04/09/2026 on Lou's ruling (OUTSTANDING ^o272); bloodtx:pump was rejected as the home for these because it is IV infusion therapy, a different clinical use and a different framework.
